project.title: Full-Stack E-Commerce Platform – Sudu Araliya Food City
project.shortDescription: A full-featured food city e-commerce app with real-time support chat, admin panels, and AWS hosting.
project.description: Developed a responsive e-commerce application with live customer-admin chat functionality. Implemented real-time communication using WebSockets. Worked using Agile Scrum methodology for project management and iterative delivery.
features: Real-time bidirectional support chat using WebSockets.
Responsive shopping catalog, shopping cart, and checkout system.
Interactive admin panel to monitor orders, update inventory, and answer chats.
Cloud deployment on AWS EC2 with MongoDB Atlas.
